$comment: Pinned inputs for the wasm32-wasip1 libLLVM. Everything here is fetched or built by build/llvm-wasm/build.sh; nothing is vendored into the repo.

llvm.why: Crystal 1.17 supports LLVM 8-20 (see crystal-lang/crystal 1.17.0 src/llvm/lib_llvm.cr). 20.1.8 is the newest release it accepts, so libLLVM is pinned to it rather than to whatever is current. Crystal only emits wasm32-unknown-wasi, so the library target is wasm32-wasip1, and only the WebAssembly backend is built.

wasiSdk.role: Host cross-compiler: clang 22 targeting wasm32-wasip1, plus the WASI sysroot (libc). Same SDK that @live-codes/clang-wasm pins, so the two agree on the environment.

build.hostTablegen: llvm-tblgen built natively with the system compiler; its path is passed to the cross build as -DLLVM_TABLEGEN.
build.notes: Threads off (WASI preview 1 here has none), exceptions and RTTI off, no tools/tests/examples, static libraries only.
